modern: A bright open-plan living room in the modern style: clean straight lines, plain white walls, a low-profile grey fabric sofa, a slim coffee table of glass and blackened steel, a wide window with sheer curtains, warm daylight, one small plant in a ceramic pot, very little clutter.
minimalist: A very spare living room in the minimalist style: white walls, a pale oak floor, one low beige sofa, a single small side table, no decoration of any kind, wide empty floor, soft even daylight, everything reduced to what is needed.
scandinavian: A cosy Nordic living room in the scandinavian style: white walls, a pale birch floor, a light grey linen sofa with soft cushions and a knitted throw, sheer white curtains, a fiddle-leaf plant, pale wooden legs, a lot of soft daylight.
japandi: A calm Japandi living room: warm off-white plaster walls, a light oak floor, a low oatmeal linen sofa, a round wooden table, a paper-shade floor lamp, a few matte ceramic pieces, one branch in a vase, muted earth tones.
loft: A loft living room in an old industrial building: exposed red brick walls, a large steel-framed factory window, a worn concrete floor, a brown leather sofa, a black steel coffee table, a tall metal shelf, warm low sunlight.
industrial: An industrial-style living room: bare grey concrete walls, a black steel-framed window, dark ash floorboards, a charcoal fabric sofa, black metal pipe shelving, a brass pendant lamp, a muted palette of grey, black and brown.
thai: A modern Thai living room in the thai-contemporary style: pale teak wood and rattan furniture, warm cream walls, a linen sofa with a handwoven Thai cotton cushion, a round rattan coffee table, a ceramic vase holding a white orchid, warm brass lamps, tropical plants, soft golden afternoon light.
